candidates.name: Cryoglobulinemia
support_spans: Rouleaux and cryoprotein precipitate on peripheral blood smear
Elevated serum cryoglobulin levels (cryocrit, 16%)
multifocal intravascular fibrinoid material consisting of a mix of cryoglobulins and fibrin thrombi
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with purpuric lesions, elevated serum cryoglobulin levels, and biopsy findings of intravascular fibrinoid material consisting of cryoglobulins support the diagnosis of Cryoglobulinemia.

candidates.name: Multiple Myeloma
support_spans: Hypercalcemia (calcium level, 11.5 mg/dL)
Abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses
Monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis
Hypercellular marrow consisting of 80% plasma cells with atypical morphology and κ-light-chain restriction
candidates.why: The patient's laboratory findings, including hypercalcemia, abnormal paraprotein band, and monoclonal IgG-κ protein, along with the bone marrow biopsy results, support the diagnosis of Multiple Myeloma.
